title: Ay Hurre Dilawar
body:
laashe ko utha karke ye kehne lage sarwar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaata hai hamein chod ke tu jaanibe kausar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein aakar sare hur zaanu pe rakha
aur kehte thay aaqa
leta hai ajab haal mein khaaye hue khanjar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehman nawazi teri hum kar nahi paaye
moo kaise dikhaye
sharminda hai tujhse ye tera sibte payambar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsan tera ye hai ke tu haq pe hai aaya
jaan apni gawaya
iski to jaza khuld mein dengi meri madar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne se tere ahle haram karte hai matam
unko hai bahot gham
tere liye rote hai mere qasim o akbar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani na piya tune ke pyasa hi chala hai
ye dashte bala hai
tu mujhpe fida hogaya ay nasir o yawar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayenge ziarat ko tere chaahne waale
karte hue naale
hoga tera karbal ke khareeb rauza e athar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte thay dua shaah bober laash pe jis dam
aankhein rahi purnam
matam tera hota rahe ta arsh e mehshar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
author: Mir Bober Ali
